name: fetch-mix-poster
note: Shares are percent of requests. Only the classes that answer the same with no checks, with built-in protection and behind the gateway: signed-in reads and the checkout, as customer = load-0001 to load-0999. Left out of fetch-mix-1: public reads (counted per client address, and a load generator is one address), refusals (nothing refuses with no checks) and the merchant stock read (two merchant accounts would pass its per-account rate). Never change this file; write a new name instead.
